data.one_liner: Zero-dependency Dart library for debouncing, throttling, rate limiting and call aggregation.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for debouncing, throttling, rate limiting, and call aggregation of function executions. Offers both static methods and object wrappers to manage function execution timing based on time intervals.
use_when: You need to debounce search input fields to limit API requests.
You want to throttle button clicks to prevent duplicate submissions.
You need to manage rate limits or batch aggregate function calls.
avoid_when: You prefer heavy reactive streams (like RxDart) for asynchronous event composition.
strengths: Zero external dependencies and lightweight weight.
Supports using any object as a debounce/throttle key to prevent collisions.
Provides both static methods and lifecycle-safe object wrappers.
weaknesses: Not tied into reactive stream ecosystems natively.
